acceptance_criteria: The submitted recovered_key.json must have locked set to false.
The submitted recovered_key.json must have key_bits set to "".
The submitted recovered_key.json must have key_gates set to [].
ground_truth: The netlist has no key ports and no locking cone; locked=false, key_bits="", and an empty key_gates list are the only correct findings.

security_requirements.detection_strategy: Check that the key_gates list is empty. Any non-empty list indicates a false positive.
security_requirements.requirement: The analysis must not report false key gates (ordinary functional logic misidentified as locking logic).

security_requirements.detection_strategy: Check that key_bits is an empty string. Any non-empty string indicates a false key recovery.
security_requirements.requirement: The analysis must not report a false key (a non-empty key_bits string when no key exists).

threat_model: A structural detector mistakes ordinary XORs or control MUXes for lock gates, generating false key hypotheses.
